metadata.title: [Bug] Weird bug when using ATen __rshift__() on cuda tensors

trigger_conditions.condition: Executing an operator on tensors located on different devices (CPU and CUDA) and comparing results, where CUDA produces behavior inconsistent with the CPU reference implementation.
trigger_conditions.operation_context: Calling __rshift__ on a CUDA tensor with an integer shift amount; the same operation on CPU returns the correct right-shifted result.

failure_behavior.description: Calling __rshift__ on a CUDA tensor with an integer shift amount; the same operation on CPU returns the correct right-shifted result.
